messages.content: I need to access my account but I've forgotten my password. Could you help me log in with my username 'john_doe'? I'll set up a new password once I'm in.

function.name: user_authentication_login
function.description: Authenticates a user based on their username and password. It returns an authentication token if credentials are valid. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

remember_me.description: Whether to keep the user logged in for an extended period.

login_attempts.description: The number of unsuccessful login attempts before displaying a captcha.

message.content:
Sure! I can’t log in directly since I don’t have your password, but I can help you reset it so you can create a new one.

Would you like me to send a password‑reset link to the email address associated with your account? Once you receive the link, just click it, follow the instructions, and you’ll be able to set a fresh password and sign back in.
message.reasoning: The user wants to log in with username 'john_doe' but forgot password. We cannot provide password or attempt login without password. According to policy, we should not reveal or guess passwords. We can offer to reset password via email. So respond asking them to confirm they want to reset password.
